name: SpanishModelVariant411_DrawBeams
evidence: matching spanish_model_variant/variant411_beams.c: from phase 4 on builds sixteen two-point beams in four tilt groups, grows them, projects each spine and its copy along the view and draws each beam as two POLY_GT4 halves fading to black; no entry call is observed (notes/overlays/spanish-model-variant411-beams.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-394 images build it through model_variant/variant394_beams.c; the header-427/444 images build it through french_model_variant/variant444_beams.c and bind it at their own address. Bound at 0x8013C4E8/0x8013C57C/0x8017C4E8/0x8017C57C in the PAL images. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
